name: Love Blind Box The Hunter Becomes the Prey
original_name: Love Blind Box The Hunter Becomes the Prey
overview: To test his fiancée Zafira, Mauricio, heir to a multimillion-dollar empire, hides his identity and enters university as a poor student. Without knowing who he really is, Zafira makes him the target of the Love Surprise Box and bets with her friends that she will humiliate him and abandon him in a month. But Mauricio decides to play along and takes control from the shadows, turning the hunt into a public humiliation for the heirs of power.
